name: app-crowdfunding-project-list-and-detail-screens-blue-yellow
title: Crowdfunding app screens: a project list with progress bars and a detail screen with an investor bar
whatItIs: Two phone screens on a blue geometric background: 'Your projects' listing yellow-tagged project cards with photos and progress bars showing amount raised versus goal, and a detail screen for 'Powerful smart battery lamp' with a description, an investor progress bar (700 investors) and a black 'Select' button.
whatItMeans: Trustworthy and motivating; progress bars on every card make funding momentum visible at every level of the app.
techniques: Show a funding progress bar on both list and detail views.
Tag each project card in one consistent accent colour.
Pair a description with a separate social-proof bar (investor count).

vocabulary.definition: A bar showing how far a goal has been reached.
Evidence like investor counts that build user trust.
